basics.name: Matias Falconaro
basics.label: IT support analyst
basics.summary: IT Support Analyst specializing in end-to-end resolution of infrastructure, network, and connectivity incidents. Experienced in developing automation solutions to optimize operational processes, identity management, and monitoring.

work.name: W&R Producciones
work.summary: Hardware, software, and network troubleshooting; creation of knowledge base articles (KBs). Deployment and administration of VirtualBox VMs, featuring external networking, virtual switching, and physical resource allocation. Management of 100+ virtualized workstations via TeamViewer, including diagnostics, updates, configuration, and systems maintenance. Administration, configuration, and monitoring of Fortinet VPN infrastructure alongside multi-protocol tunnel deployment (IPsec, SSL/TLS, L2TP, SSTP, and WireGuard); management of access policies, user authentication, and connectivity troubleshooting for remote work and branch offices. Development and implementation of PowerShell scripts for CTI integration between IVR and CRM platforms utilizing ANI detection. Centralized identity and access management (IAM) using Active Directory for user provisioning, de-provisioning, and modifications across corporate ecosystems and monitoring tools (Salesforce CRM, LMS training platforms, and real-time supervision dashboards).

work.name: CAT Technologies Argentina
work.summary: Implementation of escalation workflows to reduce ticket transfers and decrease resolution times for complex incidents. Hybrid Network Diagnostics (HFC/FTTH): Layer 1 and Layer 2 incident resolution involving routers, modems, ONTs, and Wi-Fi Mesh extenders. IoT Ecosystem Configuration: Integration of set-top boxes (STBs), Wi-Fi IP cameras, and smart sensors across residential and corporate environments. Multichannel Technical Assistance (IVR, AnyDesk, WhatsApp): Remote support for incident resolution and end-user terminal configuration. Active Directory user profile and permission administration for account provisioning and de-provisioning across Salesforce CRM, LMS training platforms, and real-time monitoring dashboards. Critical boot and storage failure management utilizing Pre-installation Environments (PE), Live USB environments, and deployment/imaging tools. SSD, NVMe, and HDD diagnostics, SATA/PCIe interface troubleshooting, disk cloning, and GPT/MBR partitioning. BIOS/UEFI configuration, firmware updates, controller modes (AHCI/RAID), and Secure Boot setup.

work.name: Scienza Argentina
work.summary: Development and optimization of Python scripts integrated with SAP HANA to automate critical operational processes (billing, reporting, and master data), significantly reducing manual workload across the department. Data integration automation. Implementation and maintenance of ETL processes pulling from multiple sources (external APIs, CSVs, and heterogeneous databases) into centralized repositories to eliminate information silos. Standardization of technical development methodologies within the team using Git/GitHub, ensuring scalable code, peer reviews, and controlled testing environments.

work.name: Baitcon SA
work.summary: Administration and maintenance of SAP HANA Cloud integrations for internal web applications on SAP BTP. Configuration and support of automated ETL processes in headless Windows Server environments. Integration of SQL Server and Windows Server with Active Directory for centralized authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), and GPOs. Administration of an on-premise SFTP server for secure data exchange with external sources, featuring access auditing and centralized logging. Monitoring and incident resolution for data flows across systems (SAP, SQL Server, SFTP, and HANA Cloud) to ensure business continuity. Operational continuity, optimization, and execution of backup policies and disaster recovery (DR) plans for both on-premise and cloud databases.

work.name: Pilcomayo SRL
work.summary: Deployment and administration of VMware VMs, featuring internal networking, virtual switching, and physical resource allocation. Backup and disaster recovery policies incorporating data synchronization and replication between physical servers and NAS/SAN storage, with centralized log and event analysis in Splunk. Procurement and installation management of hardware (servers, switches, firewalls, storage, and printers), alongside SLA monitoring for connectivity and equipment. PowerShell, Bash, and Python scripting for repetitive tasks, utilizing Git for version control and integrating with Datadog. Monitoring of processes, services, and hardware status (temperature, disks, power supplies, and network traffic) using Zabbix for alerting and SNMP network device monitoring to guarantee critical service availability and uptime.

work.name: Pilcomayo SRL
work.summary: Hardware, software, and network troubleshooting; creation of knowledge base articles (KBs). Preventive, corrective, and scheduled maintenance for 10+ workstations, 2 servers (incorporating servers, ToR/OOB switches, KVMs, UPSs, PDUs, patch panels, rack shelves, and storage), and 6 printers, including diagnostics, component upgrades, assembly, and structured UTP/FTP cabling (TIA-568). Configuration and administration of routers, switches, and firewalls (NAT policies, ACLs, and filtering); support for analog PABX systems. Management of VLANs, subnets, routing, and port/MAC-based policies, with availability and performance monitoring via Zabbix. User provisioning, de-provisioning, and modifications (Joiners, Movers, Leavers) in Tango Gestión and LDAP, alongside role-based permission assignment and GPOs. Implementation of SSH, RDP, and SFTP tunnels with access authentication and auditing between servers, featuring centralized logging in Splunk.

work.name: Etex Group Argentina
work.summary: User assistance in the creation, release, and technical closure of Maintenance Notifications and Work Orders. Troubleshooting and guidance on the basic display and modification of Technical Objects, such as Functional Locations and Equipment. Unlocking user accounts and assigning permissions for key module transactions or specific roles for maintenance planners, supervisors, and technicians. Incident resolution for time confirmation logging issues and troubleshooting errors during the Technical Completion (TECO) of work orders. Preventive Maintenance Plans, inspection cycle scheduling, and measurement reading uploads into Measuring Points. Creation of shop floor and plant guides and manuals on how to report breakdowns and log data. Reporting of unscheduled breakdowns via corrective notifications and their subsequent conversion into urgent Work Orders.

projects.name: Local LLM RAG Agent

projects.name: KPI Traking
projects.description: Application for tracking and analyzing daily KPIs of call center agents, enabling monitoring of productivity, efficiency, and goal achievement.

projects.name: PartyPrize API
projects.description: Exposed FastAPI backend for managing guest and prize data for a company event, featuring a lightweight embedded file database and a Swagger interface.

projects.name: Expense manager
projects.description: Desktop CRUD application for managing, tracking, exporting, and visually analyzing financial transactions including expenses and revenues.

projects.name: GIS ETL pipeline
projects.description: Back-end system to retrieve data from a database and GEOJSON files, process it, and compile into JSON files for geographic project information.

projects.name: DBs ETL Pipeline
projects.description: Executable ETL pipeline for extracting, processing, validating, and transferring data from an Oracle DB to a HANA Cloud DB.
